def shipping_cost(order)
  domestic = order[:country] == "US"
  heavy = order[:weight] > 10
  express = order[:express]

  if domestic
    return express ? 50 : 20 if heavy
    return express ? 25 : 5
  end

  return express ? 100 : 40 if heavy
  express ? 60 : 15
end
